shape: Fresh scientific identity has local ordered_ids/sites/conditions and empty capture_lineage. Capture metadata stores local runner_rows, per-site projection names, local lane_receipts and arrays. No global captures list.

Exactly one fixed-schema capture_reference in identity; local expected_keys and rows plus execution references/runtime/guard/startup fields. startup_fields explicitly <=8192 serialized bytes. Actual authority guard/reservation metadata needs explicit bound; global capture count is not its schema.

Capture lineage ref has five SHA strings and two byte counts. Numeric manifest array descriptors are local to actual arrays. COMPLETE stores only this publication child relative paths/hash/bytes; no global capture table.

Global train-piece object references accumulated into capture_references and emitted ONCE in fit-completion. object_reference has path and root-file digest/length map; no file contents. Aggregate cache itself carries full local union identity/arrays once.

Validation references list is accumulated into selection metadata ONCE. Each reference contains capture and shard byte closure; repeated group capture references must be counted as physically serialized, not deduplicated by this proposal.

Per-validation-shard execution.fit_reference duplicates whole FIT bundle child descriptor closure; size scales fit array descriptors, not all target captures. Charge every real duplicate. Adapted canonical validation shards/captures are additional publications, not silently removed.
